locations.note: Battle of Hue and Reclaiming Hue: street fighting through the old city during the Tet Offensive of 1968.
Ia Drang Valley and Landing Zone Albany: the air-cavalry battle of 1965.
The Siege of Khe Sanh: the Marine base under bombardment in 1968.
Lang Vei: the Special Forces camp overrun by tanks.
Fall of Saigon and Saigon 1968: the embassy rooftop evacuation of 1975 and the Tet fighting in the city.
Quang Tri 1968 and 1972, and Operation Hastings: the fighting just below the demilitarized zone.
Hill 875: the Dak To battle of November 1967.
Operation Game Warden: river patrol boats among the delta's channels.
The Ho Chi Minh Trail: the supply road through the Laotian jungle, bombed and fought over.
Cambodian Incursion: the 1970 drive into the sanctuaries over the border.
Operation Flaming Dart and Operation Irving: air strikes on the North and a sweep of the Binh Dinh coast.
